purpose: Determine which parts of Romania's external-debt exposure are directly observable without treating reporting currency as debt denomination or original maturity as a refinancing schedule.

exact_source_examples.dataset: BPS — Balance of Payments and International Investment Position / external debt
exact_source_examples.concept: Gross external debt excluding FDI of general government, long-term original maturity, Romania, quarterly
exact_source_examples.semantic_limit: EUR is the reporting unit. Currency denominator _T means the series does not identify whether the underlying debt is denominated in EUR, RON, USD or another currency.

exact_source_examples.concept: Gross external debt excluding FDI of deposit-taking corporations except the central bank, short-term original maturity, Romania, quarterly
exact_source_examples.semantic_limit: Short-term refers to original maturity up to one year, not residual maturity or the amount contractually due in the next model period.

exact_source_examples.concept: Gross external debt of total economy, Romania, quarterly, reported in Romanian lei
exact_source_examples.semantic_limit: Changing the reporting unit from EUR to RON does not reveal debt currency composition. The currency-denominator dimension remains all currencies.

source_boundary_findings.gross_external_debt_excluding_FDI_note: Several confirmed TXD/FGED series exclude direct-investment debt. They may not be silently treated as total external debt if the mechanism requires all FX-sensitive liabilities.

prohibited_shortcuts: Infer foreign-currency share from the fact that an external-debt series is reported in EUR.
Infer RON-denominated debt share from a series whose unit of measure is RON while currency denominator remains All currencies.
Treat short-term original maturity as principal due within the next quarter.
Apply the contemporaneous exchange-rate move to all gross external debt as if none were hedged.
Combine S13, banks and other sectors into one feedback coefficient without a sector aggregation contract.
Use external-debt stock changes as refinancing flows.

admissible_next_step.rule: Reopen quantitative specification only if official/reproducible evidence provides currency denomination and residual-maturity/refinancing timing on compatible sector boundaries, with hedging either observed or explicitly bounded. Otherwise retain the mechanism as DEFERRED and the feedback architecture as an open chain.
